## Developer Guide

### AI-powered Features
- [AI-powered Features](http://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/ai-powered-features/): Use AI tools to enhance document processing workflows

### Loading, Saving and Converting
- [Create or Load a Document](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/create-or-load-a-document/): How to create new or load existing documents programmatically. All popular formats are supported
- [Save a Document](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/save-a-document/): Save documents in Word, PDF, HTML, and other supported formats
- [Convert a Document](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/convert-a-document/): Convert documents between Word, PDF, OpenOffice, and more formats. For example, convert Word to PDF, Image to PDF, PDF to Word, PDF to JPG, Image to JPG, HTML to PDF, HTML to Markdown, etc.

### Rendering & Printing
- [Rendering](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/rendering/): What is Rendering and Page layout? Flow-layout or Fixed-layout document formats
- [Converting to Fixed-page Format](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/converting-to-fixed-page-format/): Convert documents to fixed-page formats like PDF, XPS, and images. Which PDF Standard Is Better to Choose? Working with PDF/A or PDF/UA
- [Using TrueType Fonts](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/using-truetype-fonts/): Configure and embed TrueType fonts when rendering documents. Manipulate and Substitute TrueType Fonts
- [Handling Windows Metafiles](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/handling-windows-metafiles/): Control how Windows Metafiles (WMF/EMF) are processed during rendering
- [Rendering Shapes Separately from a Document](https://docs.aspose.com/words/nodejs-net/rendering-shapes-separately-from-a-document/): Render individual shapes or graphics independently from the full document
